items.source_en:
We're in trouble. Barkley assaulted a droid, and it not only killed him, it turned the whole group aggressive. The droids have flagged the entire crew as hostile, and now every single one of us is a target.

Using the intercom, I instructed the crew to stay in their quarters until we can find a way to disable them. May is trying a remote hack in hopes of finding a kill switch. But I don't know if we have time. 

I can already hear them marching toward the door.
items.legacy_ko:

인터컴을 통해 승무원들에게 놈들을 무력화할 방법을 찾을 때까지 방에 머물라고 지시했다. 메이가 킬 스위치를 찾기 위해 원격 해킹을 시도 중이다. 하지만 시간이 있을지 모르겠다.

벌써 놈들이 문을 향해 행진하는 소리가 들린다.

items.source_en: I found an old holobook of astrology (apparently I'm a Sagittarius, whatever that means) and get this - my horoscope said that "You should not be afraid of the dark cave and the truths that lie within". Obviously nonsense but it's fitting.  Guess a broken clock is right twice a day! This is the third of the these abandoned shafts that I've gone exploring in and there's tons of good stuff that they just left behind. The advent of laser mining may have been a challenge for these old big machine based mines, but they're a jackpot for scroungers like yours truly. Big mining conglomerates look at a huge piece of machinery and decide it's not worth it to drag it out but someone like me, I can spend a month poking around and tearing out old heat exchangers and make a year's salary selling them to scrappers at Geonosis Excavation Site.

items.source_en:
Governor Hurst,

I looked into what it would take to expand your condo. Realistically, I've got to say that even if you can afford it, it's not a good idea, structurally. As you know, we need to make do with the space we have in Geonosis, and adding on to the Luxe Condominiums just isn't feasible at this time without risking the integrity of the building and the structures around it. Your best bet will be to buy an adjoining unit and knock out a floor or a wall to assimilate it into what you've got. But even then, that'd hurt the Geonosis Excavation Site housing market. I urge you to wait until the Crater project is finished. Once the miners clear up enough space, maybe we can think about expanding the city into it, and pushing the mines further out to make room for more residential buildings. Sorry for the bad news.

-Anton Freidman
items.legacy_ko:
허스트 주지사님,

콘도 확장 공사에 대해 검토해 보았습니다. 현실적으로 말씀드리자면, 비용을 감당할 수 있다 하더라도 구조적으로 좋은 생각이 아닙니다. 아시다시피 지오노시스에서는 한정된 공간을 최대한 활용해야 하는데, 지금 상태에서 럭스 콘도미니엄을 증축하는 건 건물 자체와 주변 구조물의 안전을 위협할 수 있어 불가능합니다. 차라리 옆 호수를 매입해서 바닥이나 벽을 허물고 합치는 게 최선일 겁니다. 하지만 그렇게 해도 지오노시스 발굴 현장 주택 시장에 악영향을 줄 겁니다. 크레이터 프로젝트가 끝날 때까지 기다리시는 걸 권합니다. 광부들이 충분한 공간을 확보하면 도시를 그쪽으로 확장하고, 광산을 더 외곽으로 밀어내어 주거 공간을 늘리는 방안을 고려해 볼 수 있을 겁니다. 안 좋은 소식을 전하게 되어 유감입니다.

-안톤 프리드먼

locations.vanilla_source_en: Does that mean you're already a superhero, then? That's awesome.
The Lodge is kind of like a secret lair already, right? We're keeping these super-secret Artifacts here, right under everybody's noses.
Your ship smells so much better than Dad's. Like, a lot.
*sigh*
Did we just lose a weapon?!
Hmmm... I don't think it'd be a good idea to keep going without a spacesuit.
Worried? No, I think it's fascinating!
I still don't know how you lost that picture of Nibbles the Comet-Eating-Bunny.
I'll copy down, too. You know how you lose things.
Hey, how are you?
Their ship has a broken weapon!
I've always wanted to visit a place like this.
It helps to have a good teacher. Dad, don't let it go to your head.
I'm glad you got us out of that so fast.
They broke one of our weapons!
I have, Dad! I want to be as good a co-pilot for the captain as I am for you!
Oh, you must be the new member.
I'll say!
Their weapon's broken!
Riding the NAT is fun, you should give it a try if you have time to spare!
Dad says "there's rarely a dull moment." Then I remind him he's not the one who gets left on the ship.
Are they going to shoot at us?
When I'm older I'm going to explore all over Neon, and no one can tell me "no."
I know. It's not all that bad, I guess.
Nice to meet anyone brave enough to fly the Frontier.
Not. The. Same. I like smelling the pages, the feel of it. Computer screens are just bleh.
Dad says it's best to stay away from Akila City's walls.
You don't mind if I take a look at your ship's flight controls, do you? Hmm... maybe later.
Depends on what you do with your powers.
I mean, I guess so. But that's really up to you, isn't it? All the superheros could be villains, or all the villains could be heroes...
There are bad guys up ahead!
It's nice to take a break from exploring and come home once in awhile.
*Giggles* Volii Alpha should lend Akila some of its water, don't you think?
No, I know.
I asked Matteo if we can get a friend for Vasco. He said "maybe" but I'm pretty sure he was just saying it.
All of society was built upon horses. Imagine what they must've looked like for real. They look smelly, in a good way.
Or horses. Did you know that it wasn't until after the Industrial Revolution that horse speed was the maximum civilization speed for centuries?
I like books about quantum theory and astrophysics. Or science.
If you find any cool minerals, I'd love to take a look!
I checked your suit for you. No leaks!
You know, this ship isn't so bad. Just needs a little love.
Hey dad, want to hear a joke?
Really? Huh. If I was rich I'd have a list of my favorite things.
It still fits, Dad. And I love it. Now, a new book...?
Bye!
Hey Dad, want to hear a poem I wrote? It's called a "haiku." I just read about them.
Wow, thank you!
I got this one story about a talking penguin I'm working on. He's out for revenge.
You've been taking good care of my dad, right?
*Gasps* Their weapon's fixed!
Bring me back something cool from the city, okay?
Will you get me a treat at Jane's Goods?
Oh. That's too bad. I thought maybe you'd say, like, a moon or something.
I cannot wait to meet her. It's been ages since Constellation has had someone new. I wonder what she's like.
You ever heard of the Mantis? The famous bounty hunter? Some people say the Mantis has superpowers.
I... uh... seem to have left my stamp back on Dad's ship. But imagine it there. On your arm. "Cora approves!"
I have decided that I will stay. You have the Cora stamp of approval.
Are you okay, Dad? You look tired.
We need to fix that weapon, quick!
M-Maybe they'll just leave us alone...
Dad says areas like this can actually be pretty dangerous.
Now don't even think of going beyond the walls, okay?
Like how you're always jealous that Vladimir's stronger than you are?
I like going on adventures with dad, but I like being able to come home to my room, too.
Carrying us home.
Starships fly there like comets
Space is cold and dark.
How'd they fix their weapon so fast?!
There's a mountain around here that looks like a face from above!
Everybody! Skyscrapers can't jump! *Laughs*
If you're going to The Lodge, will you bring me back a few books?
It's really nice to have more company. New stories, new data-
Right, we should just... Keep an open mind.
Okay! It's called "Space". Ahem.
Dad? Can I have a pet?
It's been ages since you let me help out around the ship!
I'm glad that's over...
Dad says the miners in Cydonia are even tougher than they look!
Like more than you'd ever want to know. Hello, kids are around, people.
Hint hint. You can ask. I promise I'll be good.
But he said I have to be respectful on your ship. Buuuut... I could try and fix things if you ask.
I read. I look around the ship - but no touching. Dad lets me do all sorts of stuff on his ship.
That's not a friendly ship, is it?
Exploring places like this makes me feel like a real adventurer.
I'll limit it to the really important stuff, Dad.
Can I help out around the ship now?
One of the weapons needs to be fixed!
Oh wow, this looks like something out of a book!
I wonder if they have any good bookstores there...?
Mom says we might go to Paradiso next year. She's all excited about spa days.
You have to promise to keep everybody safe!
Is everybody okay?
I think they broke one of our weapons!
They finished their weapon repairs!
I'd love to see the scientific wing of MAST someday.
I don't really mind staying on the ship when we're in Neon.
Ehh, it's okay. Kinda wish I got to do stuff outside the ship more often.
Have any new books for me?
It should be easy to find mineral deposits around here.
Neon's great... But fish. It just smells like fish.
You better make sure your suit's all sealed up.
Careful not to fall down any mineshafts! I read a book where that happened.
Are you spacing out?
Uhm. Yeah, that makes sense.
Our weapon's repaired!
Mom says later this year we can spend a whole week together. A week!
Are we about to get in a fight?
If we're lucky, maybe we'll see some aliens.
Neon's so pretty at night. Like some sort of electric jewel.
Dad says everyone in Constellation is a hero in their own way, so... I think maybe you just need to admit it.
Dad, what does "superfluous" mean? I just read it in my book.
Somebody has to fix the shields!
I bet some of these plants would look awesome under a microscope.
Sometimes I think I might want to be a Freestar Ranger when I grow up.
You're the richest person I know. Do you have a favorite thing that you own?
Dad. Fine. You know reading computers for hours gives me a headache?
I-I'm going to head to my room, this seems dangerous.
Those guys took down our shields!
You better stop by Sinclair's Books for me!
...I hope Mom's doing okay.
You hit one of their weapons!
It's so wow!
It's amazing! He made a brand new kind of plant! Like he did it all himself.
He wrote about this experiment with some xerophytes that he found on ten different planets!
I'm reading a book about plants written by somebody from Constellation a hundred years ago!
Found any new books? Please, please?
Pester? You think I'm a pest?!
Oh good, now they can't shoot back!
Dad says Neon's WAY too dangerous for me.
Since you have your own company and you're rich, you must own a lot of things. Do you have a favorite?
That was pretty scary.
Duh! I'm only 12, you really expect me to know everything? Sheesh!
It'd be really dangerous to go any further without a suit on.

The Empire calls itself order. But order built on oppression is no order at all.

Here on Dantoo Town, we stand for something greater. The Rebel Alliance is not just a resistance—it is a promise. A promise that no matter how many worlds fall under the Empire’s grip, there will always be those who fight back. Those who refuse to kneel.

Every citizen who speaks freely, every pilot who dares to defy an Imperial patrol, every worker who dreams of a better tomorrow—you are the lifeblood of the Rebellion.

Just as the Freestar Collective stands as a symbol of freedom for the Settled Systems, so too do the Freestar Rangers serve as a symbol of freedom for the Freestar Collective itself.

Founded in the year 2231, the Rangers are the protectors of the people and ideals of the Freestar Collective. It's not enough to call them police, and too much to consider them soldiers. Rather, the Rangers are guardians - YOUR guardians - and they've dedicated their lives to the service of the Freestar Collective.

But don't take our word for it.

The Rangers welcome all inside the Rock, which serves not only as their headquarters, but as Akila City's primary meeting place and watering hole. There you can meet the members of this elite organization, and learn firsthand how committed this small, dedicated force is to the ideals first shared by Solomon Coe himself.
